<infobox theme="Media">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="title"></title>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Production information</header>
        <data source="developer"><label>Developer(s)</label></data>
        <data source="publisher"><label>Publisher(s)</label></data>
        <data source="num games"><label>Number of games</label></data>
        <data source="first date"><label>First game published</label><format><!--
        -->{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{first date|}}}}}|none||{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{first date|}}}}}|future||{{{first date|}}}}}}}<!--
        --></format></data>
        <data source="last date"><label>Last game published</label><format><!--
        -->{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{last date|}}}}}|none||{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{last date|}}}}}|future||{{{last date|}}}}}}}<!--
        --></format></data>
        <data source="genre"><label>Genre</label></data>     
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:VideoGameSeries|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.

The following code flags infoboxes that do not have parameters defined.
-->{{#invoke:InfoboxParamCheck|main|image|title|developer|publisher|num games|first date|last date|genre|optional=no_year_check,not_appearance|ignore=name}}<!--
-->{{#invoke:MediaDateCheck|main|no_year_check=1|template_name=VideoGameSeries}}<noinclude>
